messages:
jill-customer: Hey team — batch embeddings job failing for our production key, started ~2h ago. One-off tests with same key work. Getting 403 for /v1/embeddings/batch only. Job: 10k rows.

sophie-cs: thanks @jill-customer. Can you paste the failing request/response? Also which key was used? svcacct created via SSO.

jill-customer: svcacct key id svc-qa-77 (provisioned via SSO). Here's a minimal repro curl we ran:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings/batch \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer svc-qa-77" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model": "embed-large-1", "input": ["one","two"]}'
```

Response:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing scope: embeddings"}}
```

amal-eng: interesting that single-row tests pass but batch fails. Do you see any 200s earlier? any retries? Does the job split into multiple concurrent requests or use a different client lib?

jill-customer: job uses our internal batcher which does parallel shard requests (10 concurrent). Single manual curl to same endpoint (no concurrency) returns 200.

jordan-provisioning: putting 👀 on this. Hypothesis: SSO provisioner writes scopes as a CSV string into the svcacct metadata. If a parser mistakenly converts plural->singular for small scopes it could produce "embed" instead of "embeddings" and the batch router might validate scopes differently for chunked requests.

sophie-cs: @jordan any recent deploys to provisioner? Also can you check the svcacct metadata for svc-qa-77 and paste scopes value (sanitized)?

jordan-provisioning: found svc-qa-77 entry: scopes="generate,embed,rerank" — aha that's wrong, should be "embeddings" not "embed". I see a recent change in csv->claims mapper where we run a naive singularize() for tokens with length < 7 to support legacy tokens. That change shipped yesterday.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T15:12:03 completed: provisioner v3.4.1

deploy-bot: rollback candidate available: v3.4.0

amal-eng: that explains odd behavior: our batch path runs a different auth flow that strictly checks "embeddings" in the token claim, while the single-request path uses a compatibility layer that accepts "embed" aliases. So concurrent shard requests hit strict validation more often (different internal router).

sophie-cs: root cause summary: provisioner singularized "embeddings" -> "embed" for SSO-provisioned svcacct keys. Single curl path tolerated alias, batch path did not. Impact: svcacct keys provisioned after v3.4.1 may lack the correct "embeddings" scope.

jordan-provisioning: remediation plan:
- hotfix provisioner to stop singularizing scopes (PR open: https://git.internal/redwood/provisioner/pulls/1422)
- backfill impacted svcaccnts for last 24h where scopes contain "embed" -> replace with "embeddings"
- run a small migration job to patch tenants that used SSO onboarding yesterday

amal-eng: temporary mitigation: I'll add a compatibility check in batch auth path to accept "embed" as alias for "embeddings" for next 4 hours while we backfill. Pushing patch now.

sophie-cs: @jill-customer sorry for the disruption — we'll notify once backfill done. For your immediate run you can re-create a key via console manual service account flow (not SSO) which will have correct scopes.

jill-customer: thanks — re-created key and job succeeded. Please let me know when fixed so we can revert manual key.

jordan-provisioning: backfill started at 2901237000, estimated 20m for affected orgs. Will post status.

infra-bot: backfill job started: patch-provisioner-scope-backfill-2026-03-16

jordan-provisioning: backfill completed. 17 svc accounts patched. Follow-up: we added unit tests to prevent singularize transform. Will ship v3.4.2.

sophie-cs: marking customer update: patched and rolled out. Closing once customer confirms.

jill-customer: confirmed, batch run succeeded with original SSO key. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

sophie-cs: closing thread, filing incident note for postmortem and adding a note to onboarding docs about scope naming.
